description: This file defines an interface ITransactionalState<TState> that specifies transaction semantics with read/write locking capabilities for Orleans state management.

classes.name: ITransactionalState
classes.description: An interface for transactional state that supports read/write operations with Orleans transaction semantics.

methods.name: PerformRead
methods.description: Performs a read operation on the state without modifying it, returning the result.

methods.name: PerformUpdate
methods.description: Performs an update operation on the state and returns the result.
